snippet.title: Rewind 99 Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Here is a silly little reveal trailer for an upcoming game I've been working on, Rewind 99.

A group of friends and I made an open world store simulator inspired by the likes of Schedule I and TCG Shop Simulator where you take over management of the world's last video rental store. 

It won't just be enough to rent tapes though. As you fight against the emerging streaming giant, RentNet, you will need to open absurd side hustles and do whatever it takes to survive.

I'll be featuring a playable demo for R99 in Steam Next Fest from October 13-20 and plan to release it December of this year. 

Let me know your thoughts or questions in the comments - and thanks for checking it out!

#90skids #simulatorgames #indiegame #blockbuster
